# ANSYS Mechanical Automation - Remote Point Pairs from Named Selections

For this project, I needed to represent a six-degree-of-freedom spring between tracks (stationary) and rollers (dynamic). This approach used pairs of remote points that had translational/rotational constraints and whose initial position was determined by the average between the centroids.

If more pairs were required, it would definetly be worthwhile to replace the hardcoded filtering and function sequence with a dictionary that could be looped through.
```python
def avgOfCentroids(nsList):
    pts = []
    x = y = z = 0

    for ns in nsList:
        for id in ns.Location.Ids:
            pts.append(ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(id).Centroid)

    for p in pts:
        x += p[0]
        y += p[1]
        z += p[2]
    return x/len(pts), y/len(pts), z/len(pts)

def createRPs(nsList):
    coords = avgOfCentroids(nsList)
    for ns in nsList:
        c = Model.RemotePoints.AddRemotePoint()
        c.Name = ns.Name
        c.XCoordinate = Quantity(coords[0], "m")
        c.YCoordinate = Quantity(coords[1], "m")
        c.ZCoordinate = Quantity(coords[2], "m")
        c.PilotNodeAPDLName = ns.Name

        c.ScopingMethod = GeometryDefineByType.Component
        c.Location = ns

Ns = DataModel.GetObjectsByName("Named Selections")[0].Children

xRollers = [x for x in Ns if "xRoller" in x.Name]
zRollers = [x for x in Ns if "zRoller" in x.Name]
xSensors = [x for x in Ns if "xSensor" in x.Name]
zSensors = [x for x in Ns if "zSensor" in x.Name]
zSprings = [x for x in Ns if "ySpring" in x.Name]
thtaRollers = [x for x in Ns if "thRoller" in x.Name]

createRPs(xRollers)
createRPs(zRollers)
createRPs(xSensors)
createRPs(zSensors)
createRPs(zSprings)
createRPs(thtaRollers)

```
